## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PhoneStringResources — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/text/PhoneStringResources.kt

## Trigger

Every screen and ViewModel that reads PhoneStringResources (RaceListScreen, RaceDetailScreen, RaceDetailViewModel, ProfileScreen, ProfileViewModel, PasteResultScreen, PasteErrorScreen, PasteErrorViewModel, ImportPreviewScreen) and WatchStringResources (HomeScreen, HomeViewModel, ControlScreen, ControlViewModel, PreparationScreen, PreparationViewModel, ProjectionScreen, EndOfRaceScreen, WatchHistoryScreen, WaitingForPhoneViewModel, SensorPermissionViewModel) — observed.

## Today

`app-phone/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` and `app-wear/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` each hold only `app_name`. Every other user-facing text lives as `const val` or a function returning a Kotlin string template inside `PhoneStringResources` (app-phone) and `WatchStringResources` (app-wear) — e.g. `DeleteConfirm.title(name) = "Supprimer « $name » ?"`, `PasteError.tooFewTitle(count) = "$count segments sur 30"`, `Home.referenceLine(name)`, `Prep.referenceLoaded(name)`, `Control.undoLabel(segment)`. Screens and ViewModels on both apps call these objects directly rather than a resource id.

## Expected

Every user-facing string moves into its app's `strings.xml` — French only, per the resource files convention — and call sites resolve it through a resource id instead of `PhoneStringResources`/`WatchStringResources` constants. An interpolated string becomes a resource with `%1$s`/`%1$d`-style parameters, resolved with `getString`/`stringResource` and the actual values passed as parameters, never built with a Kotlin string template. This applies identically and separately to `WatchStringResources` and `app-wear/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` — a second, parallel gap — since the two apps keep separate resource files and a key needed on both sides is duplicated, never shared (TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md §10).
